Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting ambulances and aid vehicles from the requirement to post notices about estimates for health care fees and charges.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to estimates for health care fees and charges; andamending RCW 70.01.030.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 70.01.030 and 2009 c 529 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Health care providers licensed under Title 18 RCW and healthcare facilities licensed under Title 70 RCW shall provide the followingto a patient upon request: (a) An estimate of fees and charges related to a specific service,visit, or stay; and (b) Information regarding other types of fees or charges a patientmay receive in conjunction with their visit to the provider orfacility. Hospitals licensed under chapter 70.41 RCW may fulfill thisrequirement by providing a statement and contact information asdescribed in RCW 70.41.400. (2) Providers and facilities listed in subsection (1) of thissection may, after disclosing estimated charges and fees to a patient,refer the patient to the patient's insurer, if applicable, for specificinformation on the insurer's charges and fees, any costsharing p. 1 HB 2788responsibilities required of the patient, and the network status ofancillary providers who may or may not share the same network status asthe provider or facility. (3) Except for hospitals licensed under chapter 70.41 RCW andambulances and aid vehicles defined in RCW 18.73.030, providers andfacilities listed in subsection (1) of this section shall post a signin patient registration areas containing at least the followinglanguage: "Information about the estimated charges of your healthservices is available upon request. Please do not hesitate to ask forinformation."
